notes:
What's new in v1.11.0

New
- In-game HUD overlay: separate widgets you place anywhere over your game — running macros & keybinds, status, notifications, and the Reflex watermark
- Notifications pop up when a macro turns on or off, is enabled or disabled, or fires
- Move & Resize: drag widgets anywhere and resize them from the corners. Each widget has its own on/off switch and options
- Pick which apps the overlay shows in, or show it everywhere. It never blocks your game's clicks or mouse
- Smooth mouse glide for Move to and Move by, with an optional random glide time. Move by turns the camera in Minecraft and other games
- Step notes: add a note to any step, like "hotbar slot". Notes are kept in share codes, Community Macros and script mode
- Scripts: move() and move_by() take an optional glide time

Fixes
- Move by: positive Y now moves up
- Removed the Turn step, which wasn't accurate. Use Move by with a glide instead
- Stop all now shows "turned off" notifications for the macros it stops
- The "conflicting ID" debug message no longer shows
- Fixes and polish
